title: Highly recommended!
text:
Rigo was a great guide. He took us to lots of different spots. And he told interesting facts and anecdotes about the places. Very enjoyable.
I had not much expectation from that activity but it ended up being great. Would recommend it.
author: Laurent_C

title: Great intro to Seville
text: We booked the 5pm tour and it was just the 2 of us and Lina, our guide. We enjoyed a wonderful evening ride around Seville. Great intoduction to the city. Lina was wonderful, sharing her passion of history and knowledge of Seville. We had regular bikes. The city is very cycle friendly.

title: Great way to learn about the city
text: We really enjoyed seeing parts of the city from a bike. It’s nice to cover ground and not be on one’s feet all day. Lainey was an informed guide who showed us a lot and explained the history and meaning of things.

author: haychy70

title: A really good introduction to the many delights of Seville
text: Really great way to familiarise yourself with Seville. Our guide - Natasha - was really excellent. Very friendly, knowledgable and fun. She answered all of our questions with enthusiasm and gave us a list of recommended restaurants. We eat at 3 of them and they were all great. The bike tour is at a leisurely pace and takes you to places you probably wouldn’t discover on your own.

title: Great visit
text: A very intimate visit with a guide, Philippe, who was very interesting and accessible; we learned many things about Seville and its history.
